text.EN: Stay with me next time. We watch each other's backs.
text.TL: Sumabay ka sa akin sa susunod. Nagbabantayan tayo ng likod.

text.EN: Don't leave me behind like that. We survive together.
text.TL: Huwag mo akong iiwan nang gano'n. Sabay tayong mabubuhay.

text.EN: I almost got swarmed when you ran off. Stick close.
text.TL: Halos makuyog ako no'ng umalis ka. Dumikit ka lang.

text.EN: We're a team. Don't take off on your own.
text.TL: Magkasama tayo. Huwag kang aalis nang mag-isa.

text.EN: Where did you go?! You can't just vanish.
text.TL: Saan ka pumunta?! Hindi ka pwedeng mawala na lang.

text.EN: Next time, warn me before you leave.
text.TL: Sa susunod, sabihan mo ako bago ka umalis.

text.EN: Thought I was on my own out there. Stay together.
text.TL: Akala ko naiwan na akong mag-isa. Magsama tayo.

text.EN: Leaving your partner gets people killed. Keep near.
text.TL: Ang pag-iwan sa kasama ay nakakamatay. Dumikit ka.

text.EN: Glad you're back, but don't ditch me again.
text.TL: Mabuti at bumalik ka, pero huwag mo na akong iiwan ulit.

text.EN: Stick with me. We're stronger as a pair.
text.TL: Sumabay ka sa akin. Mas malakas tayo kapag magkasama.
